name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics plus 2 other science or mathematics subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and, for A level only, Further Mathematics)
notes: flagship Natural Sciences Tripos — students choose Biological or Physical Sciences pathway in Year 1; specialise in Biochemistry, Chemistry, Physics, etc. from Year 2; Chemistry and Biology or Maths required

name: Durham University
typicalOffer: A*AA, three A levels with at least one Science (Biology, Human Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics or Physics); specific grades depend on the subjects studied (e.g. Chemistry needs A*A in Chemistry and Mathematics; Mathematics needs A*A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics)
notes: broad interdisciplinary science degree spanning Chemistry, Biology, Earth Sciences and Physics; students specialise from Year 2; Chemistry or Biology required

name: University College London
typicalOffer: A*AA, Mathematics and at least one of Biology, Chemistry and Physics
notes: interdisciplinary programme drawing on Chemistry, Biology, Physics and Mathematics; students choose a primary science and a secondary science; Chemistry required

name: University of Bath
typicalOffer: A*AA, one of: Biology and Chemistry; Chemistry and Mathematics; Biology, Mathematics and Physics; Chemistry, Mathematics and Physics
notes: flexible science programme allowing combination of Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics and Physics; optional placement year available; Chemistry or Biology required

name: University of Exeter
typicalOffer: AAA, A in Mathematics, Pure Mathematics or Further Mathematics and A in either Biology, Chemistry or Physics
notes: broad first year covering Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics then specialism from Year 2; Chemistry or Biology required at A-level

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: A*AA, at least two sciences from biology, chemistry, mathematics, physics etc.; stream-specific subjects; grade A in A level maths/further maths if a maths stream is chosen
notes: flexible programme enabling Chemistry, Biology, Physics and Maths combinations; pathway to specialist honours degree; Chemistry required
